Yes—**it appears suitable for sensitive baby skin**, assuming you mean the **Bc Babycare “Cloud” baby wipes 3-pack**. The 3-pack “Cloud Moist” wipes are made with **99% purified water** plus a short list of gentle ingredients such as glycerin, sodium citrate, gluconolactone, sodium benzoate, citric acid, and disodium EDTA; the product page also highlights **no fragrance, alcohol, parabens, formaldehyde, latex, allergens, or chlorine processing**. ([bcbabycare.com](https://www.bcbabycare.com/products/cloud-moist-baby-wipe?variant=46984901460214))

If your baby has **very sensitive or eczema-prone skin**, the related **CLOUD SKIN™ Soft Wipe** looks like the more skin-focused option: it is described as **hypoallergenic, 0% fragrance, dermatologist-tested**, and has the **National Eczema Association Seal of Acceptance**; NEA lists its ingredients as aqua, citric acid, disodium EDTA, gluconolactone, glycerin, panthenol, sodium benzoate, and sodium citrate. ([bcbabycare.com](https://www.bcbabycare.com/products/cloud-skin-soft-wipe))

**Bottom line:** Likely yes for everyday sensitive baby skin. For eczema, rashes, or known allergies, check the ingredient list and try a small patch first; stop using if redness or irritation appears.
